description:
Parse every listed issue record through one loader, and make repository validation, validation capture and mutation bases call it.

## Background

Since c47d78c8, issue membership comes from the captured `.jit/issues` listing (`captured_issue_ids`, `crates/jit/src/repository_state/index.rs:118-126`) and `.jit/index.json` holds tombstones only. Three loaders parse the listed records:

- `load_records` (`crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:378-401`) checks that the index parses (`:380-384`), then parses every listed record with `serde_json` and checks its embedded id, reporting each defect as `RepositoryJudgedInvalid`.
- `effective_issues` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:785-799`) decodes the overlay-effective bytes of every listed record through `decode_issue_record` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/issue_record.rs:18`) during capture.
- `captured_active_issues` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2161-2185`) decodes the same records through `decode_issue_record`, reports a missing record as issue-not-found and a mismatched embedded id as an error; mutation bases, gate checking, archive and gate commands call it.

Kept as one change for a build reason: the three private loaders are replaced together, and an uncalled private function fails the zero-warning build.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One function in `repository_state` parses every listed issue record from a byte source into parsed records, in listing order, checking embedded ids; its errors are typed.
- [hard] REQ-02: `effective_issues` and the record parsing in `load_records` and `captured_active_issues` no longer exist; each former caller calls the loader.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each caller keeps its contract: mutation captures still return the listed issues in listing order and report a missing record as issue-not-found, and repository validation reports a missing, unparseable or mismatched record, and an unparseable index, with today's messages.
- [hard] REQ-04: Unit tests own the loader's cases: a well-formed set, a missing record, a mismatched embedded id, and an unparseable record.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: One loader parses the issue records
